item.description: This layer presents the 2020 U.S. Census Block Group boundaries of the United States in the 50 states and the District of Columbia. This layer is updated annually. The geography is sourced from U.S. Census Bureau 2020 TIGER FGDB (National Sub-State) and edited using TIGER Hydrography to add a detailed coastline for cartographic purposes. Attribute fields include 2020 total population from the U.S. Census Public Law 94 data . This ready-to-use layer can be used in ArcGIS Pro and in ArcGIS Online and its configurable apps, dashboards, StoryMaps, custom apps, and mobile apps. The data can also be exported for offline workflows. Cite the 'U.S. Census Bureau' when using this data.

linked_layer_package.description: Retirement Notice: This item type is retired. This item will be retired in December 2026. A new version of this item will be available in July 2026. U.S. Detailed Water Bodies provides a database of areal water features that identifies the water bodies or reaches that comprise the surface water drainage system of the United States. U.S. Detailed Water Bodies represents the detailed water bodies (for example, lakes, reservoirs, large rivers, and swamps) in the United States. The source of this dataset is the U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) National Hydrography Dataset (NHD) in cooperation with the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA).

decision.allowed_summary: WaterBodies/BG remains the strongest current geo Level-B candidate: public ArcGIS WKT candidate has near-paper counts/MBRs, author paper-config n_points_cell=8 reproduces paper-log HDResult, and RTDL witness agrees within the declared float64-vs-author-float32 tolerance. Exact input provenance is still not proven because author WKT files/hashes or accepted deterministic regeneration proof are missing.

why_not_exact: No author-provided WKT files or WKT hashes were found in the local goal evidence or repository search.
The current public ArcGIS export has small but nonzero point-count deltas from the paper logs (+6129 WaterBodies, +127 BlockGroups).
ArcGIS metadata establishes public source family and update/vintage hints, but not byte identity with the author /local/storage/shared/HDDatasets WKT files.
The BlockGroups service/item is updated data, not a frozen author snapshot; metadata alone cannot prove exact input bytes.
Prior RayJoin WaterBodies/BlockGroups CDB artifacts are a different representation and point-count denominator, not X-HD WKT provenance.

purpose: Search whether the current full-public WaterBodies/BG candidate can be promoted from Level-B same-source evidence to exact paper-input provenance before any new performance work.

recommended_next.if_no_external_provenance: Keep WaterBodies/BG as Level-B full-public evidence and move to another exact-input target or a separately reviewed performance-denominator design without claiming Figure 5.
recommended_next.pod_reason: No new author/RTDL execution is needed until a concrete provenance lead appears.
recommended_next.primary: Seek external dataset provenance: author WKT files/hashes, archived ArcGIS export packages, or a documented deterministic conversion path accepted by review.

related_prior_assets.reason: Prior RayJoin assets/logs mention BlockGroups/WaterBodies CDB topology and point CDB paths, but those are RayJoin CDB/topology artifacts, not X-HD author WKT files or hashes.
